THE BASICS

Pick up.
Throw down.

Classic PvP: start unarmed. Pick up glowing equipment and outlast everyone else. One hit eliminates you; ten round wins take the match. Empty weapon? Throw it, then grab another. Explosions can hurt you. Hold jump to flutter. Down + jump drops through a platform. Hold strafe to move without changing aim. Tide (or lava) rises after a grace period that allows more travel time in larger arenas. The shared camera follows every active player, zooming out as you spread apart and in as you regroup.

Terrain & weapons: grab near a door to open or close it. Bullets and explosions break crates, glass, wooden barriers, and trees; barrels explode in chain reactions. Spring pads launch you; ice changes your traction; conveyors move you. Avoid lava, acid, and sparking coils. Flames burn for five seconds, acid pools last eight, and mines stay for 25. Hold and release the plasma cannon; hold the minigun to spin up. Catch your billerang to reuse it. A second frost hit shatters a frozen target.

Zombie survival: 1–4 local players work together against endless waves. You start with a pistol and 100 health. Enemies drop health and ammunition; equipment respawns during waves. Hold grab near a downed teammate for two seconds to revive them before their 18-second bleed-out. Fallen teammates return after a cleared wave. Earn points for kills and wave clears; buy health, damage, or speed upgrades between waves. Teammates cannot shoot each other; your own explosions still hurt. Runners arrive at wave 3, brutes at wave 5.

Lobby: choose a mode, pick a species, ready each player, then select an arena. Character select: P1 A/D selects, F readies, G unlocks; P2 left/right selects, K readies, L unlocks. Controllers use left/right, south button to ready, east button to unlock/back. Enter advances when everyone is ready. W/S or controller bumpers change player count or bot difficulty. Escape goes back.

Controllers: left stick / D-pad move · south button jump · west button fire · north button grab / door / throw / revive · east button call · left bumper strafe · Start pauses. For three/four humans, keyboard controls players 1–2 and the first one/two connected controllers control players 3–4. In one/two-human games controllers map to players 1–2. Escape pauses. Desktop keyboard or controller required; internet multiplayer and touch controls are not included.
